title: RustDesk now supports true unattended remote access on Wayland
summary: RustDesk, an open-source remote desktop application, has released a feature enabling true unattended remote access on Wayland display servers. This addresses a long-standing limitation where Linux systems using Wayland required user interaction to initiate remote sessions, making automated and headless remote access impractical.
problem_solved: Enables automatic remote connections to Linux systems running Wayland without requiring physical user approval or interaction at the remote end.
why_valuable: This removes a critical barrier for Linux users who need reliable unattended remote access, competing with proprietary solutions like TeamViewer while remaining fully open-source.
